meta.title: Chigozie Alioha — IT Support to Cloud Engineer
meta.description: Chigozie Alioha is an IT support professional in Port Harcourt, Nigeria, working toward a Cloud Engineer role. Helpdesk, desktop support, infrastructure, Azure labs and networking.

hero.lead: I've spent over five years in **helpdesk, desktop support and infrastructure**, keeping 200+ people working. I'm now training for the Azure Administrator exam and building the labs to prove it.

paragraphs: I started in **IT support**, where the job is staying calm while someone's work is stuck. Five years of helpdesk, desktop support and infrastructure taught me how real systems fail: accounts, networks, hardware, and the people using them.

Now I'm taking that into the cloud. I'm following a structured roadmap to the **Azure Administrator (AZ-104)** certification, with Cloud Engineer as the goal, and I build hands-on Azure and networking labs along the way.
I like clear documentation, tidy tickets and fixes that stay fixed.
